description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProjectActivitySearchFilterParams' that extends a base class 'FilterParams'. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Time module's Data Transfer Objects (DTO), and provides filtering parameters for searching project activities by name.

classes.name: ProjectActivitySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to project activities, including allowing sorting by project activity name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter params, setting default sort field to 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectActivityName
methods.description: Returns the project activity name filter value, which can be null.

methods.name: setProjectActivityName
methods.description: Sets the project activity name filter value.
